Projects

A collection of my professional client work and personal side projects.

Client Projects

Data Integration system

As a lead for the Integrations team at Stitchflow, I managed a team of 5 engineers that delivered 70+ integrations that brings SaaS user data into the platform build purely on ReactJS frontend and FastAPI backend

April 30, 2025
FastAPI Postgres Docker Kubernetes GCP GKE Grafana Leadership

Data Pipelining and Transformation System

This is my specialization, Design and Develop data streaming systems using Apache Airflow that pulls data from multiple sources.

February 10, 2024
Airflow FastApi Postgres Docker Kubernetes AWS EKS GCP GKE Leadership

Analyza

An application that converts plain english to SQL queries, inspired by Google's Analyza research.

November 1, 2019
Python NLP Spacy Flask

Interviewbot

A chatbot that automates technical screening interview process, Enabling recruiters to screen applicants before setting a formal interview.

November 1, 2017
Django NLP Microsoft LUIS AWS

Kissflow Project Management Module

Trello like Project management suite for Kissflow Digital workspace product. This module provides a set of features to manage projects, tasks, and milestones.

January 1, 2019
Flask MongoDB Docker

Kissflow Reporting Module

A reporting platform that enables users to create reports for their workflows created on top of Kissflow product. I wrote a Python backend that generates mongo query to generate reports based on user's specification

January 1, 2019
Flask MongoDB Pandas Docker

Smart Data Query

Finding Discrepancy in Clinical trials data, the project was used for Pfizer COVID vaccine trials.

September 26, 2022
Airflow Flask Postgres Docker Kubernetes AWS EKS GCP GKE

Personal Projects

E2B Sandbox Explorer

Connect to E2B sandboxes, browse files, and run commands directly from VS Code. A VSCode extension that enables developers to interact with E2B cloud sandboxes seamlessly.

November 26, 2024
VSCode Extension TypeScript E2B API

FocusTrain - Track Your Digital Focus Journey

Chrome extension to track how your focus hops across tabs. Visualize your browsing patterns and regain control of your digital attention.

December 1, 2024
Chrome Extension JavaScript Data Visualization
